title: Laws about Sacrifices

questions.question: When were these new laws of offering to take effect?
options: When you come into the land you are to inhabit
questions.correctAnswer: When you come into the land you are to inhabit
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:2 (ESV): "When you come into the land you are to inhabit..."

questions.question: What accompanied a burnt offering or sacrifice?
options: A grain offering and a drink offering
questions.correctAnswer: A grain offering and a drink offering
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:4-5 (ESV): "Then he... shall bring a grain offering... and wine for the drink offering..."

questions.question: Did the law apply to strangers/sojourners?
options: Yes, one law for you and for the stranger
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, one law for you and for the stranger
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:16 (ESV): "One law and one rule shall be for you and for the stranger..."

questions.question: What happened to the man gathering sticks on the Sabbath?
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:35-36 (ESV): "The man shall be put to death; all the congregation shall stone him..."

questions.question: What were the people commanded to put on the corners of their garments?
options: Tassels with a cord of blue
questions.correctAnswer: Tassels with a cord of blue
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:38 (ESV): "Make tassels on the corners... and put on the tassel of each corner a cord of blue."

questions.question: What is the purpose of the tassels?
options: To remember all the commandments of the Lord and do them
questions.correctAnswer: To remember all the commandments of the Lord and do them
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:39 (ESV): "That you may look on it and remember all the commandments of the Lord and do them..."

questions.question: What offering was made for unintentional sin of the congregation?
options: One bull for a burnt offering and one male goat for a sin offering
questions.correctAnswer: One bull for a burnt offering and one male goat for a sin offering
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:24 (ESV): "Offer one bull... and one male goat..."

questions.question: What is the penalty for sinning "with a high hand" (defiantly)?
options: That person shall be cut off; his iniquity is on him
questions.correctAnswer: That person shall be cut off; his iniquity is on him
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:30-31 (ESV): "But the person who does anything with a high hand... reviles the Lord... shall be cut off."

questions.question: What was the first of the dough to be offered as?
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:20 (ESV): "Of the first of your dough you shall present a loaf as a contribution..."

questions.question: Who found the man gathering sticks?
options: The people of Israel (those who were in the wilderness)
questions.correctAnswer: The people of Israel (those who were in the wilderness)
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:32 (ESV): "While the people of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks..."

questions.question: How much flour for a bull?
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:9 (ESV): "Then with the bull... three tenths of an ephah of fine flour..."

questions.question: How much wine for a lamb?
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:5 (ESV): "And wine for the drink offering, a quarter of a hin..."

questions.question: Where was the man gathering sticks stoned?
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:36 (ESV): "Then all the congregation brought him outside the camp and stoned him..."

questions.question: The tassels warned against following what?
options: Your heart and your eyes, which you are inclined to whore after
questions.correctAnswer: Your heart and your eyes, which you are inclined to whore after
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:39 (ESV): "Not follow after your own heart and your own eyes..."

questions.question: For a ram, the grain offering was?
questions.explanation: Numbers 15:6 (ESV): "Or for a ram, you shall bring... two tenths of an ephah..."

key_verse_text: And it shall be a tassel for you to look at and remember all the commandments of the Lord, to do them, not to follow after your own heart and your own eyes...
